Found 50 items in registries @easeui:

Showing items 1-50 of 50:

- accordion (registry:component) - Expanding sections that grow to their natural height with no measuring, with arrow key navigation and closed panels skipped by Tab. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- alert (registry:component) - Banner with a colored accent stripe. Body text stays neutral so contrast never depends on the variant. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- avatar (registry:component) - Round avatar whose image fades in on load and crossfades to initials if it fails. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- badge (registry:component) - Small status pill in five colors, with a crossfade for when its variant changes. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- button (registry:component) - Button with a quick press, hairline rings instead of borders, four variants, and a 44px tap area even at small sizes. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- card (registry:component) - Bordered surface with header, content, and footer parts for grouping related content. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- checkbox (registry:component) - Checkbox on a real checkbox input, with a check mark that pops in rather than just appearing. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- command-palette (registry:component) - Command-K style search overlay that filters as you type, with arrow keys to move the highlight and Enter to select. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- copy-button (registry:component) - Copies text to the clipboard and trades its icon for a check for a moment, with a label or as a single icon. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- diff-view (registry:component) - A line-by-line diff with an added or removed mark in the gutter and a tinted row for each side. Renders a diff, doesn't compute one. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- drawer (registry:component) - Sheet that slides up from the bottom edge on the native dialog element. Drag the handle down, or flick it, to dismiss. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dropdown-menu (registry:component) - Action menu that opens from a trigger, flips upward when there is no room below, and supports a destructive item. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dynamic-island (registry:component) - A pill that morphs between a compact status line and any number of named live-activity views, the same element reshaping via layout animation each time. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- expandable-tabs (registry:component) - A row of icon tabs where the selected one expands to reveal its label, sliding a shared background pill to match. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- file-upload (registry:component) - Dropzone that also opens the native file picker, with a list below it that pops each file in and collapses smoothly on remove. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- gradient-text (registry:component) - Text filled with a slowly drifting rainbow. It pauses while off screen and holds still when reduced motion is on. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- hold-to-confirm (registry:component) - Button for destructive actions that fills while you hold it and only fires once the fill completes. Letting go early drains it back quickly. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- input (registry:component) - Text input whose focus ring grows from a hairline to two px, with a destructive ring for aria-invalid. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- insight-card (registry:component) - A stat tile: a label, a headline value, and an optional trend pill. Pass a Number Ticker as the value to have it roll in on change. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- modal (registry:component) - Centered dialog on the native dialog element that fades and scales in, leaves faster than it arrives, and keeps focus inside while open. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- morphing-search (registry:component) - A circular search button that morphs into a text field: the same element grows and reshapes via a layout animation, rather than a new one popping in beside it. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- notification-stack (registry:component) - A deck of notification cards: collapsed to the top card with peeking edges behind it, fanning into a readable list on hover or focus. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- number-ticker (registry:component) - Number that rolls to a new value like an odometer, one changed digit at a time. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- otp-input (registry:component) - One box per digit for a verification code, with paste and SMS autofill support and a shake for a wrong code. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- popover (registry:component) - A panel of arbitrary content anchored to a trigger, opening on click and flipping above it when there's no room below. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- progress (registry:component) - Progress bar that fills with scale instead of width, plus an indeterminate state for unknown durations. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pull-to-refresh (registry:component) - A pull-down gesture over scrollable content: the indicator tracks the finger 1:1, then resists past the trigger distance and spins while refreshing. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- range-slider (registry:component) - Native range input with a filled track and tick dots, so keyboard and screen reader support come built in. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- select (registry:component) - Composable select whose menu fades and scales out of the trigger, and opens upward when there is no room below. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- selection-actions (registry:component) - A floating bar of bulk actions that fades and rises in once a selection leaves zero, for pairing with Table or any selectable list. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- skeleton (registry:component) - Loading placeholder with one shimmer shared across the page. Wrap real content and it takes the same shape, then crossfades away. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- switch (registry:component) - On and off switch with a quick slide and no bounce. Inside a label, the whole row is the tap target. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- table (registry:component) - A plain, composable data table: sortable headers with an arrow that only shows on hover until active, and rows that tint when selected. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tabs (registry:component) - Pill, segment, or underline tabs with an indicator that slides to the selected tab. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- text-animation (registry:component) - One component, three ways to animate text: a scramble that resolves into place, a word or character reveal out of a blur, and a loading shimmer sweep. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- textarea (registry:component) - Textarea that grows with its content instead of scrolling, down to three rows and up to a scrollable cap. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- theme-toggle (registry:component) - Light and dark switch that reveals the new theme as a circle growing from the center of the screen or from the button itself. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- toast (registry:component) - Toasts that stay long enough to read based on their word count, and pause while hovered or while the tab is in the background. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tooltip (registry:component) - Tooltip that shows a label with its keyboard shortcut, using Command on Mac and Ctrl elsewhere. Moving along a toolbar crossfades to the next tooltip with no delay. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- agent-loading-states (registry:component) - Three loading states for AI interfaces: shimmering status text, live agent progress, and cycling reasoning phrases. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- code-block (registry:component) - A code block with a label, a copy button, and light coloring for keywords, strings, comments and numbers, with no highlighter dependency. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- flowchart (registry:component) - A sequence of steps on a dotted canvas, connected by curves that measure the actual cards and follow as you drag one. Click a step to light up its connectors, or edit an if/else step's chips with real dropdowns. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- message-bubble (registry:component) - A focused conversational surface with visual tones, independent alignment, and a speech-bubble tail that pops in on arrival. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- pixel-loader (registry:component) - A 3x3 grid of cells that twinkle on independent, randomized cycles, paired with a shimmering label and an optional live elapsed timer. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- prompt-input (registry:component) - A chat composer that grows with its content, submits on Enter, and crossfades its send button into a stop button while a reply streams. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- streaming-response (registry:component) - Wraps a response with the actions people expect once it settles: copy, replay, share, a thumbs up or down, and a list of suggested follow-up prompts. No card or border, so the answer reads as part of the page. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- streaming-text (registry:component) - Reveals a model response as it streams in, fading each newly arrived word in on its own without replaying what's already on screen. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- todo-list (registry:component) - A collapsible agent task plan with morphing status marks and a completion count. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tool-approval (registry:component) - A card for an agent action waiting on approval, with Approve and Deny that collapse into a single status pill once resolved. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- tool-chip (registry:component) - A small pill naming a tool an agent used, with a spinner, check, or error mark that crossfades in place as its status changes. [@easeui] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
